measures.name: Open Claims
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number]), 'Claim'[Is Open Claim] = TRUE())

measures.name: Reopened Claims
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number]), 'Claim'[Is Reopened Claim] = TRUE())

measures.name: GA Claims
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number]), 'Claim'[General Average Declared] = TRUE())

measures.name: Notified 2024
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number]), USERELATIONSHIP('Claim Vessels'[Notification Date Key], 'Date'[Date Key]), 'Date'[Year] = 2024)

measures.name: Notified 2025
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number]), USERELATIONSHIP('Claim Vessels'[Notification Date Key], 'Date'[Date Key]), 'Date'[Year] = 2025)
